moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description:
Water (Special)
Base Power: 150
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description:
Water (Physical)
Base Power: 60
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description:
Water (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description:
Dark (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description:
Fighting (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
This move does not check accuracy.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Damp Rock
items.description: Holder's use of Rain Dance lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Shell Bell
items.description: After an attack, holder gains 1/8 of the damage in HP dealt to other Pokemon.

items.name: Wacan Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Electric-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.description: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
